the rigid-body integrator: an explicit Euler step with re-orthonormalisation, because the game integrates in the external physics library
probe.what_the_rudder_check_shows: With the curve denominator forced to 1, 0082ECB0 reduces to MaxRotAngle * speedRatio * rudder * efficiency, so measuring MaxRotAngle at full speed and full rudder confirms the chain composes end to end. It does not confirm the game's turn rate, which is that value divided by the real curve.
